description: This file defines a static class AssetParentPseudoValidation containing utility methods for validating the 'Parent Pseudo Asset' relationship in asset management. It includes a method ValidateAndThrowAsync that enforces rules regarding the presence and correctness of parent pseudo asset references during asset creation or update.

classes.name: AssetParentPseudoValidation
classes.description: A static utility class providing validation logic for the Asset 'Parent Pseudo Asset' relationship.

methods.name: ValidateAndThrowAsync
methods.description: Validates the 'requiresParentPseudo' and 'parentPseudoAssetId' parameters for an asset. Ensures compliance with business rules such as non-null parent IDs when required, non-self-referencing, and existence checks. Throws RequestValidationException on validation failure.
